purpose: Defines execution actors, their responsibilities and write permissions, the logical script operations, Skill-script connection rules, and storage of doc-link management state.
summary: Responsibility table for caller, Skill, scripts, information-generation AI, search AI, and user with write permissions and prohibitions
Logical script operations with inputs, success results, side effects, and failure promises
AI generation results are inputs to scripts, which validate type and length
Skills run in the caller context; only the information-generation AI is separated
Skills cannot advance on self-reported success; scripts reject disallowed transitions
Internal upper limit H is never disclosed to the information-generation AI
Change-impact notification enumerates mechanically with no AI judgment in doc-link
Partial DLID embedding failure keeps written DLIDs and reports per-document problems
All generated files stay inside the project under .temp/doc-link/<skill>/
Management state is stored as deterministic JSON under .doc-link/, split per document ID and per ToC key
tasks: Deciding which actor may write or change what
Designing the information-generation AI prompt and validation
Reviewing Skill and script connection rules
title: DES-002 実行主体と処理責務
